title: Elephants May Call Each Other by Name, and Scientists Tested It
subject: African elephant

scenes.text: Only humans were thought to call each other by name. Then scientists listened to elephants.
They gave a computer model about 470 low rumbles from wild elephants in Kenya.
The model could tell which elephant a rumble was meant for, better than chance.
Then researchers played the calls back to 17 wild elephants.
The elephants answered more strongly to calls addressed to them than to calls meant for others.
Dolphins and parrots copy a friend's signature call. Elephants appear to use an arbitrary label, like a name.

description:
Wild African elephants may address each other with distinct calls, something once seen only in humans.
A computer model picked out the intended listener, and 17 wild elephants responded more to calls addressed to them.
What do you think your name would sound like?
first_comment: What would your elephant name sound like? Which smart animal should we cover next?
